justification: `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/common/HybridBinarizer.java` is a narrow thresholding utility: it extends `GlobalHistogramBinarizer` and directly depends only on `Binarizer`, `LuminanceSource`, `NotFoundException`, and `BitMatrix`, with the rest of the logic self-contained. Repository search found 9 direct instantiation sites outside the class itself, spread across 4 production files (`javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/GUIRunner.java:107`, `javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/DecodeWorker.java:136`, `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/DecodeHandler.java:76`, `zxingorg/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/DecodeServlet.java:421`) and 5 test files under `core/src/test`. That is moderate reuse, but not the strong high fan-in/high fan-out dependency hub required for HM.
